shared_elements: human figures (schematic crew strokes in A; a frontal standing personage in B)
animal or animal-like form (quadruped in A; zoomorphic/mask motifs in B)
repeated series of short vertical elements
justification: The only overlap is the generic presence of human forms and a row of repeated vertical strokes, which in A are crew marks along a boat hull and in B are simply parts of an ornate costume and background; nothing specific corresponds. A is a highly schematic silhouette scene dominated by a large upcurved boat with a quadruped above, while B is a densely detailed, naturalistic frontal standing figure laden with headdress, pectoral and hanging regalia on a monolithic shaft.
